title: Dedalus, you’re an antisocial being, wrapped up in yourself. I’m not. I’m a democrat and I’ll work and act for social liberty and equality among all classes and sexes in the United States of the Europe of the future
html_source:
McAnn is modeled after Joyce’s contemporary Francis Sheehy Skeffington. He was an ardent pacifist, feminist, and believed in the possibility of universal peace.

This dialogue is characteristic of Skeffington.
